name: gsheets-pro
description: Google Sheets for Claude Code that produces sheets a careful human would recognize as their own: native Tables, on-brand theming, readable formulas, a lint and render verify loop, and protections so an agent and a colleague can share one spreadsheet.

plugins.name: gsheets-pro
plugins.description: The house style, the verify loop, and the guardrails: skill, references, worked examples, presets, a sheet reviewer, and four hooks. Brings no MCP server of its own, so use it with a hosted gsheets-pro server, an existing Sheets connector, or the gsheets-pro-local plugin.

plugins.name: gsheets-pro-local
plugins.description: Runs the bundled gsheets-pro MCP server over stdio on your own machine, with your own Google OAuth client. Enable it alongside gsheets-pro. Not usable in Claude Code cloud sessions, which cannot start stdio servers.
